test_ray_executor: test RayPipelineExecutor runs a pipeline with configurable tasks and workers across multiple configurations
test_executor_dependencies: test that multiple child executors depend on the same parent executor and the parent runs only once
test_placement_group_creation: test RayTaskManager creates placement groups with correct bundles when nodes_per_task is greater than one
test_rank_resubmission_on_retriable_erro: test that RayTaskManager resubmits ranks when tasks fail with retriable errors like WorkerCrashedError
test_timeout_manager: test TimeoutManager tracks tasks and identifies timed out tasks after a configurable timeout period
